# Version 4.157.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m157 engine update**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release moves the native renderer to Skia m157 without changing managed API declarations. The update retains the m156 glyph-bounds guard. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 while its native HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m157** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 157, preserving the existing glyph-bounds guard and leaving managed wrappers and generated declarations unchanged. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))
